summary.en: Before you sign, read the lease, listen to the explanation and make sure you understand it. Signing is a promise to follow the terms. When a real estate agent brokers the lease, you receive an explanation of important points before signing (to be checked). Check: whether it is a regular lease or a fixed-term lease (to be checked); the security deposit, key money and any non-refundable "shikibiki" amount; whether there is a renewal fee and how much; the cost of restoring the room when you leave. The lease period is normally 2 years. Tell the landlord about anyone who will live with you; if you do not, you could be asked to leave (to be checked). Ask when you do not understand something. If you do not speak Japanese well, bring someone who does. Check the lease and ask the real estate agent (to be checked).
